title: Success requires an observed tool call with the right challenge and schema
statement: The canary passes only when the model invokes the setup-only tool with the exact random challenge against the declared schema, observed through the real pinned runtime and provider path. A response that merely claims tool support, or that calls the tool with a malformed argument, fails.
notes: ⚠️ NOT EVALUATED, 2026-09-22. EVD-0130 is component proof for TSK-0041: through Pi's real openai-completions client to a loopback endpoint, only an exact call with this run's challenge passes, and prose, malformed, extra, wrong, repeated and other-tool calls each fail under their own reason. No billable provider was called and the canary does not yet run in setup.
